[[File:Gungan_Style.png|thumb|Representative Binks dancing the Gungan Style]]
'''Gungan Style''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] dance that [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], was known for performing at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The dance consisted of a few basic moves, making it look like the performer was riding an invisible mount, alternately holding the reins and spinning a [[Lasso/Legends|lasso]], before moving into a [[Limb/Legends|leg]]-shuffling side gallop.<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This dance was seen in a [[September 14]], [[2012]] update to [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], and is a parody of the dance featured in the videoclip of "[[Wikipedia:Gangnam Style|Gangnam Style]]," a song by [[Wikipedia:South Korea|South Korean]] performer [[Wikipedia:PSY|PSY]].
